anomalies.description: Two men engage in close-quarters hand-to-hand combat on a paved ground, exchanging strikes and blocks; the man in the cap initiates with a kick and punch, while the man in black counters and controls his opponent's limbs.

The man in black subdues the man in the cap, who is now on the ground and appears helpless; the attacker delivers a final strike or control hold while the victim lies prone, indicating non-consensual violence against a subdued person.

Two men engage in a close-quarters martial arts fight on a rooftop; the man in black executes controlled strikes, blocks, and joint manipulations against the man in the cap and jacket, who attempts counter-movements. The exchange includes parries (f0–f2), clinch and control (f3–f6), redirection and wrist/neck control (f7–f10), and a final takedown attempt (f14–f15). No weapons or external aggression observed; appears choreographed combat.

Two men engage in a close-quarters martial arts fight involving rapid hand strikes, blocks, and controlled grappling maneuvers; the exchange is mutual and skillful, with both participants actively defending and attacking.

Two men engage in a physical fight: the man in the denim jacket initiates with a swing, the man in black counters with a high kick (visible at f2–f3), then executes a takedown (f6–f8), ending with him on top of the other man on the ground (f8–f9).
After the takedown, the man in black maintains control over the subdued opponent by applying a chokehold and striking his face repeatedly while he is on the ground and unable to defend himself.
